answer: Sybil resistance comes from making identity costly and traceable. Each persona must stake collateral that is burned if audit exposes it as fake, so cloning a whole grove of puppets is unprofitable. Honest work climbs a public trellis of signed attestations that any peer can replay to spot duplicate creators. Governance then sits on a single terrace: one established agent, one vote, so a botnet earns no extra voice and mass fabrication stops paying.
